pages.title: Gemsbok
pages.text: The gemsbok ($(o)Oryx gazella$()) is a large antelope of the deserts and dry grasslands of southern Africa, including the Kalahari and Namib.$(br2)Both sexes carry long, straight, rapier-like horns, and the face is boldly marked in black and white.$(br2)Gemsbok are superbly adapted to heat, able to go without drinking for long periods and to let their body temperature rise to save water.
